subtitle: Generate Power BI theme files from a text description or brand image — powered by AI agents.
text_placeholder: Describe your brand, colors, or style... e.g. "Modern fintech startup with dark blue and gold accents, professional and clean"
image_placeholder: Click to upload a brand logo or style guide
image_context_placeholder: Optional: add context about the brand...
local_text_hint: Local mode works best with named colors, industries, or moods (e.g. "blue fintech, corporate"). For open-ended descriptions, AI mode gives richer results.
footer: Theme files are compatible with Power BI Desktop
mode_local_desc: Deterministic, 100% in your browser. No AI, no network request, no data leaves your device.
mode_ai_desc: Optional. Uses your own API key, sent directly to the provider — never through our servers.
mode_key_tradeoff: Your key is stored only in this browser tab's session storage and is sent directly to the provider's API — never to our servers. It is cleared when you close the tab.
mode_error_no_key: Enter an API key to use AI mode, or switch to Local mode.
local_explanation_summary: This {tone} theme was generated locally, without AI, using {source}.
local_explanation_colors: The {count} data colors are derived mathematically using HSL color relationships from {source}, with contrast automatically adjusted to meet accessibility guidelines.
local_explanation_typography: Typography uses {fontFamily} for body text and {headerFontFamily} for headers — both are fonts pre-installed on Windows, so they display correctly for every Power BI user.
local_explanation_accessibility: {passCount} of {count} data colors meet WCAG AA contrast requirements against the background; colors close to failing were automatically adjusted.
